# Buni

> Buni LLC sets up a friendly AI receptionist for local businesses that answers every phone call and website message, books appointments directly on the business's existing calendar, and texts the owner a summary — 24/7. Based in Bradenton, Florida, serving Bradenton, Sarasota, and Lakewood Ranch in person, with remote setup available anywhere.

## What Buni does

- **Every call answered & booked**: A friendly voice answers 24/7, books straight into the calendar the business already uses (Google Calendar, Square, Jobber, and others), and texts the owner a summary of every call.
- **Every message answered**: A chat assistant on the business website and Facebook/Instagram messages that answers questions and books appointments. Missed calls get an instant text back.
- **More 5-star reviews**: Happy customers get a friendly text asking for a Google review at the right moment.
- **Additional services**: team AI training, reactivation campaigns for old quotes and lapsed customers, Google review replies, automated quotes/estimates/intake paperwork, and social media drafting with owner approval.

## Who it's for

Local service businesses — salons and spas, painters and contractors, roofers, insurance agents, law offices, and similar appointment- or lead-driven businesses.

## Integrations

Works with the tools each industry already uses (exact fit confirmed in the free consultation): Square Appointments, Vagaro, and GlossGenius for salons; ServiceTitan, Jobber, and Housecall Pro for trades; Clio, Litify, and Lead Docket for law offices; Google Calendar for everyone. Industry safety rails are built in — for example, it never gives legal advice, never quotes contractor prices, and never gives insurance coverage advice; those questions route to the business owner.

## Pricing

- One-time setup: $400–$1,000 depending on business size and tools connected.
- Monthly: $150–$500 depending on call volume.
- No long contracts, cancel anytime. Nothing goes live until the owner has heard it and approved it; full refund if not happy.
